basis: Triangle principal stretch factors from bind-rest tangent metric; area-weighted percentiles; planar skin silhouette sections centered on each bone.
limits: Measurements describe LBS geometry, not simulated cloth material stress.
A compression factor below one may be a legitimate fold. Large regions stretched above rest cannot represent an inextensible fabric without compensation.
Tiny existing seam/trim triangles are reported separately from area-weighted values so isolated slivers cannot dominate the diagnosis.
Cross-sections use a convex skin hull and may bridge open wounds; they are a silhouette diagnostic, not watertight enclosed volume.
No artistic pass is inferred from absence of triangle intersections.
regular_triangle_definition: Rest minimum altitude at least2mm; smaller trim/UV slivers remain in raw extrema but cannot alone decide a broadfabric-collapse gate.
